The '''Moorja system''' was home to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]], and part of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] and the [[Black Curs]] fled to the planet to escape the competing forces of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]] and [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Bregius Golthan]]. A group of [[New Republic Intelligence Service|New Republic Intelligence]] operatives were able to make planetfall and aid the Black Curs to escape the Imperial attention.

==Behind the scenes==
''Black Curs Blues'' gave this [[Star system/Legends|system's]] location as the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]], but the later source ''CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 15:3:21 Edition'' placed Moorja in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
